snippet.title: Kitsune: The Journey of Adashino - Gameplay Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2026 Showcase
snippet.description:
Find this game and every game from Galaxies Spring on our Steam Event page - https://store.steampowered.com/news/group/45348822/view/719040453611095010

A fox girl and her frog friend explore a dark island inspired by Japanese folklore, lit by torii gates, lanterns and neon signs. They light shrines to open new areas and use light to blind the oni chasing them. From developer Rias.
